scope: Only a new passive compat2 TB and this review report; no RTL, stimulus, checker, Tcl, wrapper or helper changes.

exact_transformations.name: packed_snapshot_declaration
fast_monitor_consumption
slow_monitor_consumption

sampling_contract.upper_32: Original signed four-state 32-bit integer epoch bit pattern
sampling_contract.consumer: Single concatenation assignment {pre_epoch,pre}=clocking.snapshot; no two-state conversion or defaulting
sampling_contract.event: Original named clocking event for each domain
sampling_contract.sequence: Record edge_ps; wait the original sole monitor #0.010; read clockvar PRE snapshot; read direct POST bits; execute all original PRE and POST gates
sampling_contract.time_labels: PRE=edge_ps-1 ps; POST=the original current edge+10 ps
sampling_contract.async_boundary: Same-time and edge-to-POST requests remain distinguished by the unchanged A records and changed-window logic

rationale: Candidate avoids separate integer clockvar handling and same-time-slot consumption of clocking inputs. Existing compat1 records motivate this change but do not prove the candidate works in XSim 2021.1.
remaining_gate: Native evidence must confirm the same original clocking skew, epoch/value alignment, all original A/T/C/Q/Z and numerical gates; static equivalence is not native acceptance.
